{{Quote|The title dates to an age when the Hutt autarchs ruled, you would not remember.|Szajin|<ref name="TORC" />}}
'''Archons''' was a title held within the ancient [[Hutt Empire]] that designated officials who were both a cultist and a judge. These individuals were selected to enforce ancient [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] practices as well as ensure the purity of their empire against any form of threat. In time, the Hutt Empire faded leading to the position similarly disappearing.<ref name="TORC" />

After the apparent death of the [[Tenebrae|Sith Emperor]], the [[Hutt Cartel/Legends|Hutt Cartel]] saw an avenue to bring about the rise of a new Hutt Empire. It was in this setting that [[Szajin]] arose where he claimed the title of Archon of the Hutt Empire as he sought to bring about the ascendance of his people.
